fieldValues.title: B7. Report and receive
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
Aim: tell the level above what happened, and have it acknowledged.

Tried: steward run reports; the desk (#35); clerk session; a pause after two unreceived reports; the control room.

- Gone wrong: 14 of 20 run reports say landed_as pending; receiving is still a thumbs-up on #31; the endSession exercise bug, a session interrupted on 10-21, merges hidden from minutes (audit); SP-63, SP-64; three owner surfaces built where one was planned.
